priorityFindings.title: Content Security Policy baseline absent
evidence: product/next.config.ts contains no security headers configuration
repository search returned no Content-Security-Policy occurrence
priorityFindings.closure: Add and test a production-compatible CSP meeting ASVS 5.0 V3.4.3, then attach repository and runtime header receipts.

priorityFindings.title: Uploaded file content is not validated against declared type
evidence: normalizeMime may infer type from filename extension
priorityFindings.closure: Validate accepted file content/signature against the allowed type before persistence/processing and add negative tests.

priorityFindings.title: L2 multi-factor authentication requirement not met
evidence: password and email magic-link are current login pathways
repository search found no MFA/TOTP/AAL2 enrollment or challenge implementation
priorityFindings.closure: Implement and require an L2-compatible factor combination for the protected application scope, with recovery/session tests and human validation.
